def transform(grid):
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    nonz={k:v for k,v in cnt.items() if k!=0}
    tc=min(nonz,key=nonz.get)
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(len(grid)) for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[r][c]==tc]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); c0=min(c for r,c in cells)
    shape=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in cells]
    h=len(grid);w=len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if all(0<=r+dr<h and 0<=c+dc<w and grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in shape):
                for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc]=tc
    return out
'''
